caption: The drawing features two large birds positioned back-to-back at the center of the composition, both facing outward. The birds are rendered in shades of pink, magenta, and white, with intricate patterns on their wings and tails. The background consists of stylized trees and foliage in varying shades of green with red trunks and branches, set against a bright blue sky. The ground beneath the birds is composed of blue, magenta, and red tones, suggesting water or a reflective surface. The scene is framed by a decorative border with a yellow upper band adorned with a repeating red and green floral motif, and a blue frame around the main image. The composition is balanced with trees on both sides and rounded shapes suggesting hills or additional trees in the distance.
title: Bandbox Design (Grouse)
